title: Emails: unique across person files, and vouched for by endorsements
description: Found by flag-day critic 2026-10-22, reproduced: a person file may list any email; emails become allowed_signers principals and git prints only the first, so a tag signed by Alice's key with torvalds@example.org listed first verifies as 'Good "git" signature for torvalds@example.org' rc 0. Endorsements bind only name+key, so nobody vouches for emails. Recommended fix (pending Mark): git vouch check fails when one email (lowercased) appears in more than one person file; migrated files may only use emails from their GPG UIDs.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate email across two person files fails check; endorsement with subjectEmails validates; export emits only endorsed emails as principals; unendorsed email produces a check warning. Real ssh-keygen signatures in fixtures.
notes: DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22): (1) check fails when one email (lowercased) appears in more than one person file. (2) Endorsements gain a subjectEmails list: the endorser vouches for those emails along with name and key. Proposed follow-on (Claude, pending Mark's DESIGN.md review): only emails covered by at least one valid endorsement become allowed_signers principals; unendorsed emails stay in the person file, are not exported, and check warns. Flag-day drafts fill subjectEmails from the certified GPG UIDs. Touches DESIGN.md (endorsement record, export), record validation, check, export, endorse command.
